title: The Thing
logline: When Bo’s big tail betrays how hard it is to meet new friends, Keen and Aida help him discover that the very thing he wants to hide may be the first thing everyone loves.

orderedEvents.text: Golden morning light. Dew sparkles on wildflowers. A honeycomb sits on a small stump. KEEN tiptoes toward it. He lifts his knees high with every step.
CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH.
Keen freezes each time. He spots the honeycomb. His eyes widen. He LICKS HIS LIPS. He reaches toward the honey. FUZZBY the bee is asleep on top of the honeycomb.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
A small snore bubble grows from his nose. Keen reaches closer to the honey. POP! The bubble bursts. Keen FREEZES.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
Another bubble slowly grows. Keen inches closer to the honey.
POP! The second bubble bursts.

beats.storyBeat: Keen attempts an exaggerated stealth mission toward Fuzzby’s honeycomb, but every crunchy step and snore-bubble pop makes the world more awake than he wants it to be. The beat is about borrowed boldness meeting tiny physical resistance.
beats.want: Keen wants to get close enough to take honey without waking Fuzzby.
beats.need: He needs to learn that rushing toward what he wants is not the same as being ready or unseen.
beats.kidRead: Keen is being silly-sneaky and the sleeping bee might wake up any second.
beats.adultRead: A child’s confidence is charmingly exposed by his own body and the environment; he is not as invisible as he thinks.
beats.emotionalIntent: Light suspense and giggly anticipation, with the honeycomb as the forbidden prize.

inputs.title: The Thing
inputs.logline: When Bo’s big tail betrays how hard it is to meet new friends, Keen and Aida help him discover that the very thing he wants to hide may be the first thing everyone loves.

orderedEvents.text: Golden morning light. Dew sparkles on wildflowers. A honeycomb sits on a small stump. KEEN tiptoes toward it. He lifts his knees high with every step.
CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH.
Keen freezes each time. He spots the honeycomb. His eyes widen. He LICKS HIS LIPS. He reaches toward the honey. FUZZBY the bee is asleep on top of the honeycomb.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
A small snore bubble grows from his nose. Keen reaches closer to the honey. POP! The bubble bursts. Keen FREEZES.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: ZZZZZ …
Another bubble slowly grows. Keen inches closer to the honey.
POP! The second bubble bursts.

beats.storyBeat: Keen attempts an exaggerated stealth mission toward Fuzzby’s honeycomb, but every crunchy step and snore-bubble pop makes the world more awake than he wants it to be. The beat is about borrowed boldness meeting tiny physical resistance.
beats.want: Keen wants to get close enough to take honey without waking Fuzzby.
beats.need: He needs to learn that rushing toward what he wants is not the same as being ready or unseen.
beats.kidRead: Keen is being silly-sneaky and the sleeping bee might wake up any second.
beats.adultRead: A child’s confidence is charmingly exposed by his own body and the environment; he is not as invisible as he thinks.
beats.emotionalIntent: Light suspense and giggly anticipation, with the honeycomb as the forbidden prize.
